dependency: The preferred procedure requires a fresh full-suite rerun before diagnosis, on the hypothesis that fresh execution supplies indispensable context. In this deterministic model, necessity is questionable because the failure remains constant and retained run evidence can expose the initiating message. This is a necessity argument, not observed evidence about why the stipulated operator reran.

predictions.account: Visibility-mediated causal return path hypothesis: a full rerun resets selection to a tail without the initiating message; downstream-only evidence then encourages a further full rerun, which resets selection again. The selection reset is stipulated; the encouragement and recurrent decision link are unobserved hypotheses. O5 alone does not establish them.
predictions.when: Reset separate tabletop repetitions to completed run-1 and cross no rerun versus one full rerun with independently assigned tail versus full view. Keep the initial diagnosis demand, concealed scoring procedure, 12-minute budget and valued outcome identical. Charge every action and log the selected run, visible lines, initiating-record visibility and next scripted-policy action.
predictions.result: If the hypothesized feedback policy applies, tail-only arms should produce more subsequent full-rerun requests or downstream follow-ups than full-view arms, including after the same initial full rerun. A full view should enable an evidence-backed initiating citation without another full run. These are predictions for scripted policies or separate tabletop repetitions, not measured operator behavior.

predictions.account: Reversed causal arrow hypothesis: downstream-only visibility causes the next rerun demand, rather than an independently necessary rerun producing a demand for downstream inspection.
predictions.when: Before any new execution, independently assign the retained run-1 tail or full view while keeping the initial diagnosis demand and budget fixed. Record the next action before allowing any requested rerun. Repeat after the same fixed initial full rerun with run-2 tail or full view independently assigned.
predictions.result: If visibility causes rerun demand under the exercised policy, changing only the view should change the following action even in the no-rerun arm. If rerun demand is independent of visibility, following actions should remain unchanged across views. Either result would be bounded to the exercised policy; the stipulated trace does not decide the reversed arrow.

predictions.account: Return-link interruption hypothesis: the recurrent transition from downstream-only evidence to another full rerun sustains the proposed loop.
predictions.when: Hold an initial full-suite rerun request fixed in both repetitions and retain the same diagnosis demand, fixture, scoring rule and 12-minute outcome. After the resulting run-2 tail, intercept only a subsequent full-rerun request and substitute one full-view action on retained run-2 before any further execution. Compare with the same scripted policy allowed to perform that recurrent full rerun; log both the requested and executed actions.
predictions.result: If the return link matters, exposing run-2 line 8 should allow commitment of B2, CONFIG missing region, run-2 after one full rerun, while the uninterrupted policy may reset to a tail again and consume another four minutes. Any second full rerun already violates the at-most-one-rerun outcome, regardless of eventual accuracy. Success after interruption is hypothetical and requires an actual viewed-record citation; it cannot be inferred merely from saved time.

predictions.account: Rival fresh-execution necessity account: new full-suite execution supplies indispensable diagnostic information beyond retained evidence. Rival visibility-independent policy account: the chosen policy reruns or follows B7 for reasons unaffected by root visibility.
predictions.when: Under identical starting history and scoring, compare committed diagnoses after a retained run-1 full view with diagnoses after a fresh run-2 full view, and compare next actions across the independently assigned views. Include a concealed negative fixture with line 8 replaced by progress to detect unsupported fixture-answer guessing.
predictions.result: A valid initiating citation from a viewed retained run-1 would refute fresh-execution necessity for this unchanged synthetic fixture. Identical full-view records provide no stipulated additional information favoring a fresh run. Unchanged next actions across views would fail to support the visibility-mediated decision link and remain compatible with a visibility-independent policy. A guessed B2 configuration diagnosis on the negative fixture is invalid and cannot count as successful root diagnosis.

surviving_outcome: Hypothesized surviving valued outcome without the preferred dependency: from completed retained run-1, inspect its full view and commit the actually viewed citation B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8. One full-view action costs one simulated minute and uses zero new full-suite reruns, satisfying the 12-minute and at-most-one-full-rerun limits if the citation is committed and scored correctly without losing the initiating record. The B7 focused output alone is insufficient because it names a missing B2 prerequisite but omits the configuration message. No exercise has been executed here, and no real productivity or human benefit is claimed.
unknowns: The causal reasons for the stipulated O5 decisions are unobserved; no repeated visibility-driven full-rerun loop has been established.
The following-action response depends on the selected scripted policy or tabletop repetition; one deterministic record cannot establish population behavior or human decision causality.
Within-packet blinding is procedural and not guaranteed; outcome claims require commitment before scoring and citations from evidence actually viewed.
Real analyst motivations, actual CI cost and cognitive effort are unavailable.
Changing, nondeterministic or multiple-root failures could change the value of fresh execution; this deterministic result would not resolve those cases.
